command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# --version prints "0.6.1 (using HTSlib version 1.21)" -- the tool version is field 1
MV=$(MethylDackel --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $1}')
echo "== the SAME caller, on the other aligner's BAM =="
MethylDackel extract --mergeContext chrS.fa bwm.bam -o bwm 2> md.log || { tail -10 md.log; exit 1; }
cat bwm_CpG.bedGraph

# MethylDackel is 0-based half-open over the CpG; normalise to the 1-based C (see the page)
awk 'NR>1{printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", $1, $2+1, $5, $6}' bwm_CpG.bedGraph | sort -k2,2n > bwameth_calls.tsv
sort -k2,2n -o truth.tsv truth.tsv
sort -k2,2n -o bismark_calls.tsv bismark_calls.tsv
echo "planted        bismark+MD     bwameth+MD"
paste truth.tsv bismark_calls.tsv bwameth_calls.tsv

NSITES=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' bwameth_calls.tsv)
test "$NSITES" = "3" || { echo "expected 3 sites, got $NSITES"; exit 1; }

VT=no; VB=no
diff -q truth.tsv         bwameth_calls.tsv >/dev/null && VT=yes || diff truth.tsv         bwameth_calls.tsv || true
diff -q bismark_calls.tsv bwameth_calls.tsv >/dev/null && VB=yes || diff bismark_calls.tsv bwameth_calls.tsv || true
test "$VT" = yes && test "$VB" = yes

TOT=$(awk '{n+=$3+$4} END{print n}' bwameth_calls.tsv)
test "$TOT" = "30" || { echo "calls total $TOT, expected 30"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'Methylation -- two ALIGNERS, one caller: does the aligner change the calls?\n'
printf 'methyldackel_version\t%s   (the SAME pin used on the Bismark alignments)\n' "$MV"
printf 'sites\t%s   (assert 3)\n' "$NSITES"
printf 'bwameth_exact\t%s   (assert yes -- EXACT vs the planted truth)\n' "$VT"
printf 'aligners_agree\t%s   (assert yes -- bwa-meth and Bismark alignments give IDENTICAL calls)\n' "$VB"
printf 'calls_total\t%s of 30 reads   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION)\n' "$TOT"
printf 'note\tthe earlier check varied the CALLER with the aligner fixed; this varies the ALIGNER\n'
printf 'note\twith the caller fixed, so a difference here would be attributable to alignment alone.\n'
printf 'note\tThere is none: on these reads the choice of bisulfite aligner does not move a single count.\n'
printf 'note\tThe fourth cell of the 2x2 is impossible, not skipped -- bismark_methylation_extractor\n'
printf 'note\tparses XM:Z: tags that bwa-meth does not write, so MethylDackel is the only caller that\n'
printf 'note\tcan serve as the fixed pivot.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-aligners.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
